command_argv:
set -e; python3 - <<"PY"
import hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
base=Path("docs/05_任务交接/P9_KNOWN_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_PREFLIGHT_CAPABILITY_REVALIDATION_V1/evidence")
manifest=json.loads((base/"immutable_manifest.json").read_text())
changed=[]; missing=[]
for p,h in manifest["files"].items():
 path=Path(p)
 if not path.exists(): missing.append(p); continue
 actual=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 if actual!=h: changed.append((p,h,actual))
print("manifest_files",len(manifest["files"])); print("missing",missing); print("changed",changed)
assert not missing and not changed
status=subprocess.check_output(["git","-c","core.quotePath=false","status","--porcelain"],text=True).splitlines()
allowed_prefix="docs/05_任务交接/P9_KNOWN_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_PREFLIGHT_CAPABILITY_REVALIDATION_V1/"
unexpected=[]
for line in status:
 p=line[3:]
 if p=="CURRENT.md" or p.startswith(allowed_prefix): continue
 # inherited parent changes must be represented by the frozen manifest and are allowed
 if p in manifest["files"]: continue
 # untracked directories under inherited parent tasks are represented file-by-file by manifest
 if p.endswith("/") and any(k.startswith(p) for k in manifest["files"]): continue
 unexpected.append(p)
print("unexpected_current_task_scope",unexpected)
assert not unexpected
print("head",subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip())
